<!--
  The simple contacts (model contacts@1): the heading, a description and the contacts as a list on a card
  surface, each with an icon picture (a disc), the name, a line and an action. Axes: layout (cards: columns, the
  copy centred by the align setting, rows: the icon beside the copy), cols (2, 3 columns).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { ContactItem } from "./contacts-simple.types";

export type ContactsSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  items: ContactItem[];
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  layout?: "cards" | "rows";
  cols?: "3" | "2";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  description = "",
  items,
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "center",
  layout = "cards",
  cols = "3",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<ContactsSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const itemsAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
  : "items-start"
);
const selfAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
  : ""
);
const grid = computed(() => ((cols as string) === "2") ? "md:grid-cols-2" : "md:grid-cols-3");
const item = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "rows" ? "flex flex-row items-start gap-4"
  : (align as string) === "center" ? "flex flex-col items-center gap-4"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "flex flex-col items-end gap-4"
  : "flex flex-col items-start gap-4"
);
const copyAlign = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "rows" ? "start"
  : (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const copyText = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "rows" ? "text-start"
  : (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="contacts-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Stack gap="12" align="stretch">
        <Stack gap="4" :align="column" :class="cn('max-w-2xl', selfAlign)">
          <Title :as="level" size="3xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text v-if="description" size="base" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <List tag="ul" :class="cn('m-0 w-full list-none p-0', cn('grid grid-cols-1 gap-6', grid))">
          <ListItem v-for="c in items" :key="c.id"
            :class="cn('rounded bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground border border-border', item)"
            data-slot="contact"
          >
            <MediaFrame :alt="c.title" :src="c.image" ratio="1/1" class="size-12 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
            <Stack gap="4" :align="copyAlign">
              <Stack gap="2" :align="copyAlign">
                <Title :as="(level + 1)" size="lg" weight="semibold" :class="copyText">
                  {{ c.title }}
                </Title>
                <Text v-if="c.description" size="sm" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', copyText)">
                  {{ c.description }}
                </Text>
              </Stack>
              <LinkButton v-if="(c.actionLabel && c.actionHref)" variant="default" size="sm" :href="urlOf(c.actionHref)">
                {{ c.actionLabel }}
              </LinkButton>
            </Stack>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
      </Stack>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
